Model Family Class

Source: R/S7-family.R
MVBU_Family.Rd

Encapsulates the mathematical primitives, moment extraction, and naming conventions for a distributional model family in MVBeliefUpdatr.

Registers a model family in the package registry. Accepts either an MVBU_Family object directly (recommended) or a family name with associated class names and Stan model configuration.

Usage

MVBU_Family(
  family_names = list(),
  density_function = function() NULL,
  sampling_function = function() NULL,
  expected_moments = function() NULL,
  marginal_moments = NULL,
  sufficient_statistics_function = NULL,
  stanmodel = NULL
)

new_mvbu_family(
  name_short,
  name_long = NULL,
  name_details = NULL,
  density_function,
  sampling_function,
  expected_moments,
  marginal_moments = NULL,
  sufficient_statistics_function = NULL,
  stanmodel = NULL
)

register_model_family(
  family,
  category_representation_class = NULL,
  cognitive_model_class = NULL,
  stanmodel = NULL,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

Arguments

family_names

A list containing name_short, name_long, and name_details. Default: list().

density_function

Density function function(x, rep, log = FALSE).

sampling_function

Sampling function function(rep, n = 1L, with_replacement = TRUE, ...).

expected_moments

Function function(rep) returning list(mu, Sigma, weights).

marginal_moments

Optional function returning marginal predictive moments. Default: NULL.

sufficient_statistics_function

Optional function returning sufficient statistics. Default: NULL.

stanmodel

Optional list bundling stanmodel_name and stanfit_class for Stan model families, or NULL. Used when family is a character string. Default: NULL.

name_short

Short uppercase identifier for the family (e.g., "UVG").

name_long

Long descriptive name. Default: name_short.

name_details

Optional list specifying tier class/type names: CategoryRepresentation_name, CategoryTemplate_name, CognitiveModel_name, CognitiveModelList_name. Default: NULL.

family

An MVBU_Family object, or character string specifying the model family short name.

category_representation_class

Name of category-representation class. Used when family is a character string. Default: NULL.

cognitive_model_class

Name of cognitive-model class. Used when family is a character string. Default: NULL.

overwrite

Logical indicating whether to overwrite an existing registration for this family. Default: TRUE.

See also

new_mvbu_family(), register_model_family(), get_model_family()

Examples

# Inspect a registered model family
reg <- get_model_family_registration("UVG")
reg$names$name_long
#> [1] "Univariate Gaussian Ideal Observer"

# Create a custom minimal family object
dummy_fam <- new_mvbu_family(
  name_short = "CUSTOM",
  density_function = function(x, rep, log = FALSE) rep(0, nrow(x)),
  sampling_function = function(rep, n = 1L, ...) matrix(0, n, 1),
  expected_moments = function(rep) list(mu = 0, Sigma = matrix(1, 1, 1))
)
dummy_fam
#> <MVBeliefUpdatr::MVBU_Family>
#>  @ family_names                  :List of 3
#>  .. $ name_short  : chr "CUSTOM"
#>  .. $ name_long   : chr "CUSTOM"
#>  .. $ name_details:List of 4
#>  ..  ..$ CategoryRepresentation_name: chr "CUSTOM_CategoryRepresentation"
#>  ..  ..$ CategoryTemplate_name      : chr "CUSTOM_CategoryRepresentationTemplate"
#>  ..  ..$ CognitiveModel_name        : chr "CUSTOM_CognitiveModel"
#>  ..  ..$ CognitiveModelList_name    : chr "CUSTOM_CognitiveModelList"
#>  @ density_function              : function (x, rep, log = FALSE)  
#>  @ sampling_function             : function (rep, n = 1L, ...)  
#>  @ expected_moments              : function (rep)  
#>  @ marginal_moments              : NULL
#>  @ sufficient_statistics_function: NULL
#>  @ stanmodel                     : NULL
